This substitutes one Git refspec wildcard and compares the result only to a validated tracking-ref string. It is not a sanitizer or executable code. Git refspecs permit one wildcard per side. A replacement callback separately preserves literal dollar characters in branch names.

realFixes.change: Reuse linear repository suffix trimming instead of an unanchored trailing-slash regex.
Use a replacement callback so valid dollar characters stay literal in refspec comparisons.
realFixes.redTest: Existing wildcard mapping was unnecessarily extended for topic/x$&.
